latest_release.name: v0.51.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

### Bug Fixes
- name the Intel gap in npm install, drop unused switcher settings, correct key tool descriptions
- **tap:** a Home Screen label never takes an icon above another app's label (carnet#93)
- **tap:** a point tap waits a step's settling delay, not the frame-settle timeout (carnet#91)
- **tap:** say when a point tap left the screen unchanged, as text taps do (carnet#91)
- **runner:** replace unmaintained chrono with jiff and take url 2.5.9 (RUSTSEC-2026-0543, -0592)
- **ocr:** read in a fresh process when this process's Vision model left its cache (carnet#90)

### Documentation
- **readme:** quick start under the first demo, plain words, six-row docs table
- **readme:** lead with the three demos and cut the text by half
- **readme:** drop the comparison table
- **changelog:** npm Intel note and removed App Switcher settings in 0.51.0
- correct claims the code contradicts, add SECURITY.md and a PR template, welcome pull requests
- **changelog:** 0.51.0
- **changelog:** 0.50.4
- **website:** recut demo videos to open on the action and blur third-party names

### Chores
- bump version to 0.51.0

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jfarcand/mirroir-mcp/compare/v0.50.3...v0.51.0

detail.readme:
# mirroir-mcp [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/mirroir-mcp)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mirroir-mcp) [![Build](https://github.com/jfarcand/mirroir-mcp/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jfarcand/mirroir-mcp/actions/workflows/build.yml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue)](LICENSE) [![macOS 15+](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-15%2B-black?logo=apple)](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421) [![Rust 1.99+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-1.99%2B-orange?logo=rust)](runner/README.md) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1481795325953048627?logo=discord&label=Discord)](https://discord.gg/u8ug9QCSqF) [![jfarcand/mirroir-mcp MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/jfarcand/mirroir-mcp/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/jfarcand/mirroir-mcp) ### Let your agent use your real iPhone: errands across your apps, automations, even games. **Your phone. Your apps. Your agent.** Cloud phone services rent you a phone. mirroir drives the one in your pocket, and turns what your agent does once into skills and tests you keep.

Website · Demos · Set up with your agent · Tools · Changelog · Discord

"Be my DJ": the agent asks for a vibe, builds a Gui Boratto-style playlist in Spotify and starts it. A real iPhone, sped up.

No Developer Mode, no Xcode, nothing installed on the phone. mirroir-mcp drives your iPhone through macOS iPhone Mirroring, with the apps already signed in on it: no connector, no OAuth, no password handed to anyone. It works with Claude, Codex, Cursor and other AI apps that support MCP, through [43 tools](docs/tools.md). ## Quick start You need macOS 15 or later and an iPhone connected through [iPhone Mirroring](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421). Paste this into your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, …): ```text Set up mirroir-mcp so you can drive my iPhone: follow https://github.com/jfarcand/mirroir-mcp/blob/main/docs/onboarding.md step by step, and finish by reading back what my iPhone screen shows. ``` Or install it yourself: ```bash npx -y mirroir-mcp install # or: brew tap jfarcand/tap && brew install mirroir-mcp npx -y mirroir-mcp doctor # names anything left to fix ``` OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and the other clients: [Install](docs/install.md). ## How it works ```text your agent ──MCP──▶ mirroir ──iPhone Mirroring──▶ your iPhone │ explore ──▶ SKILL.md ──▶ compile ──▶ replay, no LLM ──▶ CI: pass · fail · DRIFT ``` Your agent drives the phone through mirroir's tools. What it learns stays: an exploration becomes a skill, a skill compiles to a replay that needs no model, and the replay runs in CI. ## How it reads the screen `describe_screen` is the agent's eyes, and it has two modes. One setting, `screenDescriberMode` in [`settings.json`](docs/configuration.md), picks between them. | | Local OCR (default) | AI vision | |---|---|---| | What it reads | Text, with exact tap points ([Apple Vision OCR](docs/screen-intelligence.md#apple-vision-ocr-default)); icons through an on-device [YOLO model](docs/yolo-models.md) | Text and icons by name ("Wi-Fi", "Spotify"), including faint labels and on/off states OCR can miss | | Where it runs | On your Mac, free | Through your agent ([`embacle`](docs/screen-intelligence.md#ai-vision-mode-embacle) by default), about 25k tokens and a few seconds per read | | Tap points | Exact | Approximate, so check before tapping near the bottom of the screen | | Setting | `"screenDescriberMode": "ocr"` | `"screenDescriberMode": "vision"` | Start with OCR. Switch to vision when the screen is mostly icons, or its text is too faint for OCR. ## The framework - **[Tools](docs/tools.md).** 43 MCP tools: tap, type, swipe, read the screen, listen, launch, and [`run_steps`](docs/tools.md#tool-list) to repeat a sequence in one call. - **[Skills](docs/skills-and-ci.md#skills).** `generate_skill` explores an app and writes SKILL.md files your agent follows. - **[Compiled replay](docs/compiled-skills.md).** `mirroir test` replays a skill from the CLI with no AI in the loop: deterministic, no tokens. - **[App knowledge](docs/APP.md.spec.md).** APP.md files and [screen recipes](docs/components.md#screen-patterns-recipes) describe an app's screens once, for every agent. - **[mirroir-run](docs/mirroir-run.md).** One YAML scenario drives the iPhone, a browser, HTTP and subprocesses, with a third verdict beside pass and fail: `DRIFT` (exit 65), when the output moved past its baseline. - **Notes and sharing.** `save_note` keeps one lesson per app for the next session; [`mirroir-mcp serve`](docs/cli.md#serve) shares the phone over HTTP. ## More demos

A saved recipe reel becomes a grocery list: the agent listens to the video and reads its frames. Sped up.

Chess against Chess.com's strongest bot: the model reads the board, Stockfish picks, mirroir plays. See Games. Sped up.


Reads the ETA in Waze, posts it in Slack.
Tests a login screen in Expo Go.
## Why mirroir - **Nothing to install on the phone.** The iPhone stays stock: no signing, no provisioning profile, no on-device agent. - **Your Mac stays yours.** Through macOS 26, taps, typing and swipes reach the mirror without bringing it to the front, so you can keep working; on later macOS they bring it forward. - **It hears the phone, too.** [`listen`](docs/tools.md#listening) turns what the phone plays, a reel's narration or a voice message, into text. macOS transcribes it on the Mac: the audio never leaves it. Needs macOS 26. ## Safety - **Read-only by default.** Only the 14 read-only tools are exposed until you allow more in [`permissions.json`](docs/permissions.md); `blockedApps` keeps agents out of apps like Wallet. - **Passwords stay yours.** mirroir never presses a password or Touch ID sheet. - **No telemetry.** The only default network call is a daily version check (`updateCheck: false` turns it off). - **Kill switch.** Quit iPhone Mirroring, lock the Mac or quit the MCP client: input stops at once. See [Security](docs/security.md) and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## Documentation | | | |---|---| | [Install](docs/install.md) | Every install path and per-client setup | | [Tools](docs/tools.md) | What each tool does, with its parameters | | [Skills and CI](docs/skills-and-ci.md) | Skills, `generate_skill`, `mirroir test` | | [Games](docs/games.md) | Playing games, frame by frame | | [Security](docs/security.md) and [permissions](docs/permissions.md) | What mirroir can do, and how to limit it | | [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md) | Debug mode and common issues | Everything else: [docs/](docs/). ## Community Join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/u8ug9QCSqF) to ask questions and share skills. Pull requests are welcome: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Report a vulnerability privately: see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## License Apache 2.0 - Copyright 2026 [Async-IO](https://async-io.live). --- > **Why "mirroir"?** — It's the old French spelling of *miroir* (mirror). A nod to the author's roots, not a typo.
